high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of a mobile application or website displaying COVID-19 statistics for various Indian states. The interface includes tabs at the top labeled "Overview," "Statistics," "Testing," and "Symptoms." The "Statistics" tab is currently selected. Below the tabs, there is a list of four Indian states: Assam, Jharkhand, Uttarakhand, and Jammu and Kashmir. Each state has two pieces of information displayed: The first number represents the total number of cases (in lakhs, indicated by "L").
